# SmolLM2 (HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M) layout for the pebble chip.
#
# Template: pebble/SmolLM/CMakeLists.txt — the phase9 realization of the same
# family bind (LlamaForCausalLM importer artifacts placed in the model
# directory ROOT: models/models/SmolLM2/forward.mlir + subgraph0.mlir +
# arg0.data, generated by smollm2-model-build; NO arg1.data blob — the driver
# buddy-smollm2-main.cpp hardcodes the fixed 16 input ids measured from the
# official GPT-2-style BPE tokenizer, which buddy's TextContainer does not
# implement). Runtime deps are arg0.data + vocab.txt only.
# @forward signature (read from the emitted forward.mlir):
#   memref<134515040xf32> + memref<1x16xi64> -> memref<1x16x49152xf32>
# arg0.data = 134,515,040 float32 (538,060,160 B) = 134,515,008 trainable
# params + 32-elem rotary inv_freq buffer (SmolLM2/HANDOFF.md). Storage
# correction opposite to the SmolLM round: this checkpoint's model.safetensors
# genuinely stores BF16 (all 272 tensors, HANDOFF measured), so the importer's
# fp32 load is a value-preserving bf16 -> float32 upcast; the arg0 blob stays
# float32 and the packing convention is unaffected.
# Model facts: hidden 576, 30 layers, 9 q-heads / 3 kv-heads (GQA), SwiGLU MLP
# intermediate 1536, hidden_act silu, RMSNorm eps 1e-5, RoPE theta 100000
# (SmolLM-135M has 10000), max positions 8192, vocab 49152,
# tie_word_embeddings. Canonical causal_ppl = 5.052739; driver fail-hard
# per-position argmax expectation:
#   [346, 253, 655, 28, 436, 253, 1838, 8180, 3365, 4161, 281, 253, 1165,
#    6560, 281, 2306].
#
# Host-linalg form (upstream precedent: pebble/llama2, pebble/BertMedium,
# pebble/Pythia, pebble/SmolLM — none pass -convert-linalg-to-tile /
# -convert-tile-to-buckyball / buckyball_assign_physical_banks): every op of
# both generated graphs lowers to riscv64 host loops and no buckyball dialect
# op is ever created. archs/ CMakeLists.txt defines the tile->buckyball
# machinery variables for pebble, but this layout deliberately does not use
# them. Grounding is the bind-round observation recorded in the PR body (this
# round, run locally against subgraph0.mlir with the pebble per-chip buddy-opt
# at compiler/thirdparty/buddy-mlir/build/pebble/bin, all invocations exit 0;
# the pipeline re-confirms phase9's SmolLM breakpoints bit-for-bit because the
# two checkpoints share the same architecture and the compiler is unchanged
# since phase9):
#   - SiLU model-path trigger: BREAKPOINT (D-s-1, re-confirmed identical).
#     SiluBall (funct7 59 / ballId 11) is in the pebble registry since PR #33,
#     yet the 30 silu semantic sites still cannot reach it. The graph
#     decomposes each site into the negate -> exp -> add(1.0) -> reciprocal ->
#     mul five-atom chain (1x16x1536 f32); -convert-linalg-to-tile raises only
#     751 tile.matmul + 332 tile.transpose (identical counts to the phase9
#     SmolLM run) and leaves every elementwise chain inside linalg.generic
#     (math.exp x90 / math.rsqrt x61 / math.log x30 / math.fpowi x61 survive
#     in generics at stage B); -convert-tile-to-buckyball then produces
#     buckyball.mem_transpose x332 with zero buckyball.silu (grep count 0 in
#     the C-stage IR). Neither the midend (-convert-linalg-to-tile) nor the
#     tile->buckyball conversion has any silu/elementwise-activation fusion
#     pattern, so the five-atom chain never becomes a tile op. Derived spec
#     D-s-1 (phase9) holds verbatim.
#   - transpose model-path trigger: compile-reachable but unshippable carrier
#     (D-p-1, re-confirmed bit-identical). 332/332 f32 sites ->
#     buckyball.mem_transpose; bank-SSA + -assign-physical-banks exit 0; the
#     D-stage IR expands this 134M-param host-resident graph to 3,046,453
#     lines with 266,177 memref.alloc, 131,449 mvin + 131,449 mvout pairs,
#     525,796 mset and 263,230 fence — the exact phase9 SmolLM numbers.
#   - RMSNorm: BREAKPOINT (phase8 D-p-2, same type): the 61 rsqrt sites never
#     leave linalg.generic in either pass (no LayerNorm-pattern trigger; the
#     LayerNormBall C={4,64,256,512}/eps contract does not cover C=576 eps
#     1e-5 RMSNorm anyway, s2 brief §5).
# The driver's per-position argmax fail-hard gate is the layout's correctness
# contract on the host carrier; the canonical reference lives in the workload
# dir (reference/smollm2_logits_f32.bin + HANDOFF.md).

set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER ${RISCV_GNU_TOOLCHAIN}/bin/riscv64-unknown-linux-gnu-g++)

set(MODEL_SMOLLM2_DIR ${MODEL_DIR}/SmolLM2)
set(BUCKYBALL_SMOLLM2_DIR ${BUCKYBALL_DIR}/SmolLM2)
set(INTERFACE_DIR ${BUDDY_MLIR_DIR}/frontend/Interfaces)

add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT forward.o
  COMMAND ${BUDDY_BINARY_DIR}/buddy-opt ${MODEL_SMOLLM2_DIR}/forward.mlir
            -pass-pipeline "builtin.module(func.func(tosa-to-linalg-named, tosa-to-linalg, tosa-to-tensor, tosa-to-arith), empty-tensor-to-alloc-tensor, convert-elementwise-to-linalg)" |
          ${BUDDY_BINARY_DIR}/buddy-opt
            -buffer-deallocation-simplification
            -convert-linalg-to-loops
            -eliminate-empty-tensors
            -llvm-request-c-wrappers
            -convert-math-to-llvm
            -convert-math-to-libm
            -lower-affine
            -convert-scf-to-cf
            -convert-cf-to-llvm
            -convert-arith-to-llvm
            -expand-strided-metadata
            -finalize-memref-to-llvm
            -convert-func-to-llvm
            -reconcile-unrealized-casts |
          ${BUDDY_BINARY_DIR}/buddy-translate --buddy-to-llvmir |
          ${BUDDY_BINARY_DIR}/buddy-llc -filetype=obj -mtriple=riscv64 -O2 -mattr=${BUCKYBALL_RISCV_MATTR} -float-abi=hard -o forward.o
  DEPENDS ${MODEL_SMOLLM2_DIR}/forward.mlir
  COMMENT "Building forward.o"
  VERBATIM)

add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT subgraph0.o
  COMMAND ${BUDDY_BINARY_DIR}/buddy-opt ${MODEL_SMOLLM2_DIR}/subgraph0.mlir
            -pass-pipeline "builtin.module(func.func(tosa-to-linalg-named, tosa-to-linalg, tosa-to-tensor, tosa-to-arith))" |
          ${BUDDY_BINARY_DIR}/buddy-opt
            -eliminate-empty-tensors
            -convert-elementwise-to-linalg
            -convert-tensor-to-linalg
            -one-shot-bufferize="bufferize-function-boundaries"
            -llvm-request-c-wrappers
            -convert-trace-to-llvm="cycle-trace"
            -expand-strided-metadata
            -convert-linalg-to-loops
            -buffer-deallocation-simplification
            -bufferization-lower-deallocations
            -convert-vector-to-scf
            -lower-affine
            -convert-scf-to-cf
            -convert-cf-to-llvm
            -convert-vector-to-llvm
            -convert-math-to-llvm
            -convert-math-to-libm
            -convert-arith-to-llvm
            -convert-func-to-llvm
            -finalize-memref-to-llvm
            -reconcile-unrealized-casts |
          ${BUDDY_BINARY_DIR}/buddy-translate --buddy-to-llvmir |
          ${BUDDY_BINARY_DIR}/buddy-llc -filetype=obj -mtriple=riscv64 -O2 -mattr=${BUCKYBALL_RISCV_MATTR} -float-abi=hard -o subgraph0.o
  DEPENDS ${MODEL_SMOLLM2_DIR}/subgraph0.mlir
  COMMENT "Building subgraph0.o"
  VERBATIM)

add_library(BuckyballSMOLLM2 STATIC forward.o subgraph0.o)
set_target_properties(BuckyballSMOLLM2 PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX)
add_dependencies(BuckyballSMOLLM2 smollm2-model-build)
add_executable(buddy-buckyball-smollm2-run ${MODEL_SMOLLM2_DIR}/buddy-smollm2-main.cpp)
add_dependencies(buddy-buckyball-smollm2-run BuckyballSMOLLM2)

target_include_directories(buddy-buckyball-smollm2-run PRIVATE ${INTERFACE_DIR})
set(BUDDY_SMOLLM2_LIBS BuckyballSMOLLM2 ModelTestCRunnerUtils)
target_link_libraries(buddy-buckyball-smollm2-run -static ${BUDDY_SMOLLM2_LIBS})

set(SMOLLM2_OUTPUT_DIR ${BUCKYBALL_OUTPUT_DIR}/SmolLM2)

add_custom_command(TARGET buddy-buckyball-smollm2-run POST_BUILD
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${SMOLLM2_OUTPUT_DIR}
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
          $<TARGET_FILE:buddy-buckyball-smollm2-run>
          ${SMOLLM2_OUTPUT_DIR}/buddy-buckyball-smollm2-run
  COMMENT "Copying Buckyball SmolLM2 executable to output directory"
  VERBATIM
)

add_custom_target(sync-buckyball-smollm2-deps
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${SMOLLM2_OUTPUT_DIR}
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${SMOLLM2_OUTPUT_DIR}/trace/cycle
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
          ${MODEL_SMOLLM2_DIR}/arg0.data
          ${SMOLLM2_OUTPUT_DIR}/arg0.data
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
          ${MODEL_SMOLLM2_DIR}/vocab.txt
          ${SMOLLM2_OUTPUT_DIR}/vocab.txt
  DEPENDS
          ${MODEL_SMOLLM2_DIR}/arg0.data
          ${MODEL_SMOLLM2_DIR}/vocab.txt
  COMMENT "Syncing SmolLM2 runtime deps to output directory"
  VERBATIM
)

add_dependencies(buddy-buckyball-smollm2-run sync-buckyball-smollm2-deps)
